actions.add_blocked_time.description: Block off a specific time range on a calendar.
actions.add_blocked_time.props.calendarI: The numeric ID of the calendar to add this block to.
actions.add_blocked_time.props.end.descr: The end date and time for the block (ISO 8601 format).
actions.add_blocked_time.props.notes.des: Optional notes for the blocked off time.
actions.add_blocked_time.props.start.des: The start date and time for the block (ISO 8601 format).
actions.create_appointment.props.addonID: Select addons for the appointment. Addons are filtered by selected Appointment Type if available.
actions.create_appointment.props.adminBo: Set to true to book as an admin. Disables availability/attribute validations, allows setting notes, and makes Calendar ID required.
actions.create_appointment.props.calenda: Numeric ID of the calendar. Required if booking as admin. If not provided, Acuity tries to find an available calendar automatically for non-admin bookings.
actions.create_appointment.props.datetim: Date and time of the appointment.
actions.create_appointment.props.email.d: Client's email address. (Optional if booking as admin).
actions.create_appointment.props.labelId: Apply a label to the appointment. The API currently supports one label.
actions.create_appointment.props.noEmail: If true, confirmation emails or SMS will not be sent.
actions.create_appointment.props.notes.d: Appointment notes. Only settable if booking as admin.
actions.create_appointment.props.smsOptI: Indicates whether the client has explicitly given permission to receive SMS messages.
actions.create_appointment.props.timezon: Client's timezone (e.g., America/New_York). Required for accurate availability checking.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.find_appointment.description: Find appointments based on various criteria, including client information.
actions.find_appointment.props.appointme: Show only appointments of this type.
actions.find_appointment.props.calendarI: Show only appointments on the calendar with this ID.
actions.find_appointment.props.email.des: Filter appointments by client e-mail address.
actions.find_appointment.props.firstName: Filter appointments by client first name.
Filter appointments by client last name.
actions.find_appointment.props.maxDate.d: Only get appointments on or before this date.
actions.find_appointment.props.maxResult: Maximum number of results to return (default 100).
actions.find_appointment.props.minDate.d: Only get appointments on or after this date.
actions.find_appointment.props.phone.des: Filter appointments by client phone number. URL encode '+' if using country codes (e.g., %2B1234567890).
actions.find_client.description: Finds client based on seach term.
actions.find_client.props.search.descrip: Filter client list by first name, last name, or phone number.
actions.reschedule_appointment.descripti: Reschedules an existing appointment to a new date/time.
actions.reschedule_appointment.props.adm: Set to true to reschedule as an admin. Disables availability validations.
actions.reschedule_appointment.props.app: Select the type of appointment (used for finding new available slots).
actions.reschedule_appointment.props.cal: Numeric ID of the new calendar to reschedule to. If blank, stays on current calendar. Submit 0 to auto-assign.
actions.reschedule_appointment.props.dat: New Date and time of the appointment.
The ID of the appointment to reschedule.
actions.reschedule_appointment.props.noE: If true, rescheduling emails or SMS will not be sent.
actions.update_client.props.currentFirst: The current first name of the client to update.
actions.update_client.props.currentLastN: The current last name of the client to update.
actions.update_client.props.currentPhone: The current phone number of the client to update. Helps identify the client if names are not unique.
actions.update_client.props.newEmail.des: Client's new email address. Leave blank to keep current.
actions.update_client.props.newFirstName: Client's new first name. Leave blank to keep current.
Client's new last name. Leave blank to keep current.
actions.update_client.props.newNotes.des: New notes about the client. Leave blank to keep current.
actions.update_client.props.newPhone.des: Client's new phone number. Leave blank to keep current.
triggers.appointment_canceled.descriptio: Triggers when an appointment is canceled.
triggers.new_appointment.description: Triggers when a new appointment is scheduled.
